description.fun: Duskull can turn invisible and slip through walls, and once it picks a target it follows doggedly until dawn. It's said to spirit away disobedient children, a story told to make them behave, and anyone whose energy it drains is left with an intense chill. Its look combines the Grim Reaper's robe, a skull mask and a single floating eye.
description.guide: A Ghost-type Pokémon resembling a small Grim Reaper with a skull mask and a single floating eye. It lives in thick forests and mountains and comes out at night. It evolves into Dusclops at level 37.
description.tagline: A one-eyed reaper said to spirit away naughty children

description.fun: Dusclops's hollow body is wrapped in bandages and can suck in anything like a black hole; nothing that goes in ever comes back out. It hypnotises opponents by waving its hands and its single eye, then makes them do as it says. It feeds on drifting will-o'-the-wisps, and its glowing red eye is said to be its true form, though no one has ever seen that for certain.
description.guide: A Ghost-type Pokémon with a hollow, bandaged body and one red eye, possibly inspired by a haunted paper lantern. It evolves from Duskull at level 37 and into Dusknoir when traded holding a Reaper Cloth.
description.tagline: A bandaged ghost whose hollow body swallows anything

description.fun: The antenna on Dusknoir's head picks up transmissions from the spirit world telling it to bring souls there, and nobody knows whether it acts of its own will or is just following orders. It guides the spirits of the dead to the afterlife, carrying them inside the mouth on its belly, and occasionally takes a living soul by mistake, which is why people fear it.
description.guide: A Ghost-type Pokémon introduced in Generation 4, which guides spirits to the afterlife and has a mouth on its belly. It evolves from Dusclops when traded holding a Reaper Cloth and is the final form of Duskull.
description.tagline: A ghostly guide that carries souls to the spirit world
